title: Tom and His Dog
text:
Tom has a small dog. His dog is called Max. Max is brown and very happy. Every morning, Tom takes Max for a walk in the park.

Max needs food and water every day. Tom gives him food at 8 o'clock. Tom also takes Max to the vet once a year. Max likes his life with Tom very much.

questions.text: What is the name of Tom's dog?
What time does Tom give Max food?
How does Max probably feel about Tom?
Why does Tom take Max to the vet?

vocabulary.definition: a short trip on foot for exercise or fun
used to say that something happens all the time, in each case
a doctor who takes care of animals
what people and animals eat to stay alive

paragraph_translations: Tom ma małego psa. Jego pies nazywa się Max. Max jest brązowy i bardzo szczęśliwy. Każdego ranka Tom zabiera Maxa na spacer do parku.
Max potrzebuje jedzenia i wody każdego dnia. Tom daje mu jedzenie o ósmej. Tom zabiera też Maxa do weterynarza raz w roku. Max bardzo lubi życie z Tomem.
